item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 06/Nov/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, the weather will be slightly cooler over the south China coast tomorrow. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening, it will be generally fine with daytime temperatures rising over southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coastal areas early next week.
